recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It restores the published Pharmacy clarification in the active current source, removes a misleading exact-date narrowing, and preserves the later FHIR-37372 guidance for usage period plus last administration date/time.
issue_request: FHIR-14833 was a Published Pharmacy change request for STU3, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking to allow approximate dates for MedicationStatement.effective[x] when a patient cannot remember an exact medication date. The accepted resolution said dateTime already supports year-only, year/month, and exact-date precision, that fuzziness beyond those forms should be conveyed as text, and that this guidance should be added to MedicationStatement effectiveTime.
initial_application: Jira comments identify svn/git commit 73c779d3aeb5a6120955eb499d67727c2fdfdf47 as the original application. That commit added the requested partial-date wording to the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet comment. The current build no longer uses that spreadsheet source; after later source refactors and effective[x] edits, the active StructureDefinition retained the trailing text instruction but described effectiveDateTime as documenting an exact date/time without explicitly preserving the partial-date guidance.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is in current build scope through source/fhir.ini, which lists medicationstatement=MedicationStatement and MedicationStatement=mst. The core primitive dateTime definition still permits partial dates such as year and year/month. A later already-published reconciliation for FHIR-37372 updated the same MedicationStatement.effective[x] comment to explain usage period plus last-administration-date recording with two MedicationStatement resources; this fix layers the FHIR-14833 clarification on top of that later guidance. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml and the corresponding source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-event-mapping-exceptions.xml copy so effectiveDateTime can document the medication date/time including partial dates such as year or year/month, and so fuzzier values than dateTime precision should be conveyed as text.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml: clarified MedicationStatement.effective[x] comment to mention partial date precision and text for fuzzier values.
source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: kept the Event mapping exception copy of the effective[x] comment synchronized with the StructureDefinition.

related_jiras.note: Already represented on the combined branch; it updated the same effective[x] comment for the usage-period-plus-last-administration case and this edit preserves that guidance.
